label: Estate
gloss: The constellation read as one thing: every repo that opted in, its branches, sessions, writes and chats. The app's views over it (Activity, Map, Lists, Files) are the app's own closed vocabulary, so a view is the label under this subject rather than a subject of its own.

label: Repo
gloss: One repository, read through the app's repo-group views: Overview, Pages, Atlas, Config. Estate membership and a declared landing are attributes of the repo, not types of subject. Public browse shows a repo outside the estate under this same type.

label: Project
carrier: app/index.html, repo mode on a workspace
gloss: A workspace inside a repo, declared in the repo's manifest: its overview, board, pages and docs, and where it frames an app, that app. A subject between repo and file, which is where the sidebar already nests it.

label: Branch
gloss: A branch across the estate, read as a form: its guide, its diff, its PRs and its standing against the default branch. A pull request has no page of its own and is reached through its branch.

label: Session
gloss: One session's record from the private store, read as a form: what it did, which branches it left, and what it said. A session known only from a commit trailer is a stub of this type.

label: Page
gloss: An HTML page: it draws itself, so it is its own carrier and its subject is itself. Promotion (`appView` in a manifest) gives a page a name, an icon and a bare frame, and is an attribute of the page rather than a type; the page is still what is on screen.

label: File
carrier: pages/toss-render.html, or the viewer it routes to
gloss: A repository file that no browser draws on its own: markdown, source, an image, a PDF, a workbook, a Word document. Which renderer, and what a note can aim at inside it once open, is the routes-kinds row.

label: Data
gloss: Structured data read in a multi-mode viewer rather than as bytes: a record array, a nested object, a delimited table.

label: Fileset
gloss: Several files carried together by an envelope, which is what gives them one address: a chat or trawl results set today.
